Name: Datable Npc photos For Alternative Textures (redundant as of 1.6)
Author: LxttieDxll
Description:
I wasn't expecting something like this to become base game. I might change it up a bit, but for now it's not going to be updated for a while. If I do bring it back, it will be with all the villagers, not just the dateable ones. And perhaps a more unique frame. Until then I'll leave this up for those who are still playing 1.5.

These were inspired by LennonsLemons' bachelor plushies.
Found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16716

Want a photo of your loving partner? Or maybe you're just a stalker. Either way you can now hang the face of your beloved up on your walls.

I couldn't find another mod with something like this, but I miss things all the time. I will be making more frame colors and possibly the other villagers too.

These were made with the game sprite, I just put them in the frames really. I just wanted Sebastian on my wall next to his plushie.
They replace the CalicoFalls Painting.


This Mod requires Alternative Textures and SMAPI
Found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246   https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400


This is my first time modding.
